comments:
e13590e9: /*
 This routine is the installation routine for patch DGJ*1*3. It checks the
 environment, runs pre-install tasks, and runs post-install tasks.
 */

eed3ae0b: /*
 Entry point for the installation routine. This section checks that the
 required programming variables are set up correctly before proceeding.
 */
1a31b8f3: Clear the XPDABORT variable to allow installation to proceed.
32c48eaa: Check if the DUZ, DUZ(0), DT, and U variables are properly set. If not, display error messages and go to the ABRT label.
89d39fb1: Display an error message.
c78c7503: Display an error message.
8340ba10: Display an error message.
b9ccb90a: Display a message indicating that the environment check was successful.
1ce6974d: Exit the EN label.

a09cd1e0: /*
 This section is executed if the environment check fails. It sets
 the XPDABORT variable to 2, which indicates that the installation
 should be aborted.
 */
39b31e2b: Set the XPDABORT variable to 2 and exit the ABRT label.

db702cbf: /*
 This section runs pre-installation tasks. In this case, it deletes
 the data dictionary definition for field 10.04 in file 393.
 */
166f1d2f: Set up the variables required for the DIK utility to delete the data dictionary definition.
9802bf67: Execute the DIK utility to delete the data dictionary definition.
abff6835: Exit the PRE label.

603c4c4a: /*
 This section runs post-installation tasks. It marks the 'DGJ LOCAL
 VENDOR ADD' option as 'out of order' and displays a message.
 */
7ec34810: Initialize variables for working with the OPTION file.
1aa33882: Set up variables for the DIC utility.
f4c11c51: Set the option name to be marked 'out of order'.
af44f466: Execute the DIC utility to find the option. If found, continue with post-install tasks.
d7137055: Display an error message.
3214408b: Display a message indicating that the option is being marked 'out of order'.
53a08ba3: Set the text to be displayed for the 'out of order' option.
e8834ab6: Execute the OUT^XPDMENU utility to mark the option 'out of order' and display the specified text.
8af8f1b8: Exit the POST label.
